stories.headline: Deadly Israeli Strikes Erode Cease-Fire in Lebanon Fighting between Israel and Hezbollah has shown little sign of abating, with Hezbollah also continuing to attack Israeli troops, and both sides accusing the oth
stories.summary: Fighting between Israel and Hezbollah continues with little sign of abating, despite a US-brokered truce. Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon have killed 17 people, including two children. The conflict has persisted since the November 2024 ceasefire, with both sides accusing each other of violations. The death toll has exceeded 300, with more bodies being found. Israel has carried out its largest attack on Lebanon since the conflict began, killing at least 254 people and wounding 837. Hezbollah has also continued to attack Israeli troops, with strikes on Beirut largely stopped. The renewed conflict has prompted warnings from Iranian officials, as the situation in Lebanon remains volatile. The US-brokered truce has failed to hold, with both sides showing no signs of easing tensions.

stories.headline: Gaza reports new casualties in strikes The ongoing conflict in Gaza has resulted in more casualties following renewed Israeli strikes, according to the Gaza Health Ministry. Officials reported that a
stories.summary: At least four people were killed and 15 others injured in Gaza in the past 24 hours due to renewed Israeli strikes, according to the Gaza Health Ministry. The ongoing conflict has resulted in a significant number of casualties, with Israeli air strikes killing at least 16 Palestinians across the Gaza Strip. A total of 19 Palestinians were killed on Sunday in three separate strikes on residential buildings in central Gaza and Gaza City. The Gaza Health Ministry reported that over 100 people lost their lives in a deadly 24-hour period. The strikes have escalated, compounding existing hardship for Gaza's residents, who have faced years of blockade, economic isolation, and repeated conflicts, leaving communities with limited resilience. The conflict continues to result in significant casualties and damage to residential areas.

stories.headline: Jospong Group, VYNCKE Forge Landmark Waste-to-Energy Partnership for Africa at IFAT, Germany The Jospong Group of Companies (JGC) has entered into a strategic partnership with Belgian clean energy technology firm VYNCKE to jointly promote scalable waste
stories.summary: The Jospong Group of Companies has partnered with Belgian clean energy firm VYNCKE to promote scalable waste-to-energy solutions in Africa. The partnership was formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed on May 6, 2026, at IFAT in Germany. The agreement aims to jointly develop waste-to-energy projects, with VYNCKE providing its expertise in clean energy technology. Jospong Group's Executive Director for Waste Processing, Mr. Haidar Said, and VYNCKE's Business Development Director, Jef Mestdagh, signed the MoU. This collaboration is expected to contribute to Africa's waste management and energy challenges. VYNCKE, a fourth-generation family business founded in 1912, has a global presence with over 400 employees. The Jospong Group has existing waste management agreements, including a memorandum of understanding with the Lagos State government in Nigeria.

stories.headline: Mass support for petition to protect Argentina glaciers from mining expansion The amendment to the national Glacier Law relaxes restrictions on mining and oil activities in the areas surrounding glaciers. This reform was spearheaded by Ja
stories.summary: Argentina's national Glacier Law has been amended to relax restrictions on mining and oil activities near glaciers. The reform allows provinces to decide which areas to protect from mining and which to open up to extraction. This change has sparked widespread concern, as glaciers are vital sources of water. The amendment was passed by the Argentine National Congress last month, despite the potential environmental risks. Mining activities can have severe impacts on local ecosystems, and the new law may lead to increased exploitation of glacier regions. A petition has gained mass support, calling for protection of Argentina's glaciers from mining expansion, highlighting the importance of preserving these areas for their role in providing access to water. The move has been met with opposition, citing the need to balance economic benefits with environmental protection.

stories.headline: Why Are People Getting Rid Of ChatGPT After OpenAI recently struck a deal with the U.S. government, people have been getting rid of its ChatGPT service by the millions in favor of Claude.
stories.summary: Millions of users are abandoning ChatGPT in favor of Claude, a large language model developed by Anthropic, an American artificial intelligence company. This shift comes after OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT, struck a deal with the US government. Anthropic focuses on AI safety and has developed Claude as a range of large language models. While ChatGPT was initially popular, some users have been disappointed with its coding capabilities, with the free version of Claude outperforming it in some tests. As a result, users are migrating to Claude, potentially due to concerns over OpenAI's partnership with the government and the desire for alternative AI solutions. Anthropic's emphasis on AI safety may also be a factor in the switch to Claude. The move has significant implications for the AI market and the future of language models.

stories.headline: Europe May Soon Get a Non-U.S. Alternative to Unreal Engine But it sounds like it will be built with AI.
stories.summary: Arjan Brussee is developing a European alternative to Unreal Engine, called Immense Engine. Brussee stated that currently, no European-hosted engine complies with the region's rules and regulations. The new engine's codebase is expected to be heavily assisted by AI. This project aims to provide a non-US alternative to Unreal Engine, potentially utilizing European AI models. Existing alternatives to Unreal Engine include Unity, CryEngine, and the open-source Godot Engine. The development of Immense Engine is seen as a significant move, as it could provide a European-based solution for game development, adhering to the region's specific regulations and standards. Brussee's project is still in its early stages, with details on its AI-assisted development and potential release date yet to be announced.

stories.headline: Fans Think New GTA 6 Emails From Sony Signal Something Big It sure does seem like Take-Two and Sony are ramping up for some sort of big Grand Theft Auto 6 marketing push
stories.summary: Sony has sent emails to fans who have Grand Theft Auto 6 on their wishlist or have a history with GTA 5, encouraging them to upgrade to a PlayStation 5 in preparation for the game's launch on November 19, 2026. The emails have sparked excitement among fans, who believe a major marketing push is imminent. The messages are part of a confirmed marketing partnership between Sony and Rockstar, the game's developer. Fans who have received the emails are being targeted based on their interest in GTA 6 or their playing history with GTA 5. The emails have been shared online, with many speculating that a big announcement or reveal is coming soon. The partnership between Sony and Rockstar is fueling the speculation, with fans eagerly anticipating more information about the highly anticipated game.

stories.headline: 'Stop Ruining the Game': Helldivers 2 in Damage Control as User Reviews Hit 'Mostly Negative' Nerfdivers - The life of a live service game is punctuated by damage control – and Helldivers 2 has been no stranger to controversy since it exploded in 20...
stories.summary: Helldivers 2 is facing a backlash from players, with its Steam reviews currently sitting at "Mostly Negative". The game's battle pass system, called "Warbonds", has been a point of contention, as it can be purchased with in-game currency or via microtransactions. Players have expressed frustration with the game's current state, leading to a wave of negative reviews. The game's overall ranking on Steam has dropped to "Mostly Positive" as a result. A recent Reddit AMA with game developer Johan Pilestedt was intended to address player concerns, but it appears to have had the opposite effect. The negative reviews have highlighted issues with the game, prompting the developers to enter damage control mode to address player concerns and improve the game's reputation. The game's developer, Arrowhead Games, faces a challenge in reversing the negative sentiment.

stories.headline: Arne Slot vows to win back Liverpool fans after being booed during frustrating Chelsea draw
stories.summary: Liverpool manager Arne Slot has expressed confidence in winning back the trust of the team's fans after being booed during a 1-1 draw with Chelsea at Anfield. Slot acknowledged the frustration of the crowd and understood their reaction to the substitution of Rio Ngumoha. Despite the negative response, he remains "100 per cent convinced" that he can regain the support of the fans next season. Slot admitted that it may not be possible to win them back this season, but is optimistic about the team's prospects after the summer transfer window. He promised that Liverpool will be a different team next season, implying that changes are expected to improve the team's performance and appease the fans. Slot's comments come after a disappointing draw with Chelsea, which sparked frustration among the Anfield crowd.

stories.headline: Galway survive scare to peel away from Kildare
stories.summary: Galway secured their third win in the Leinster Senior Hurling Championship, defeating Kildare at St Conleth's Park in Newbridge. The match saw Kildare take an early lead, with Muiris Curtin scoring a goal and the team building a 1-7 to 0-1 advantage after 13 minutes. By halftime, Kildare was ahead by 10 points. However, Galway staged a comeback in the second half, scoring four goals to turn the game around. Goals from Conor Whelan, Cian Daniels, and Tom Monaghan proved decisive, helping Galway overcome the deficit and ultimately outscore Kildare by nine points. The win marked Galway's third victory in the championship, while Kildare's gallant effort ultimately fell short despite their strong start. The match was Galway's first visit to Newbridge in 50 years.

stories.headline: Leicester hit Northampton for six as league leaders crumble in fiery derby
stories.summary: Leicester Tigers defeated Northampton Saints 41-17 in a bad-tempered East Midlands derby. The hosts scored six tries, with Freddie Steward capping the victory and hooker Jamie Blamire crossing for a brace. The win bolstered Leicester's Gallagher Premiership title hopes and marked a record home league win over the league leaders. The match was feisty, with tensions running high between the two teams. Leicester's impressive performance saw them dominate the game, ultimately leading to a convincing 24-point victory. The result will have significant implications for the Premiership standings, with Leicester strengthening their title challenge and Northampton's lead at the top potentially narrowing.

stories.headline: Avalanche at Minnesota Wild Game 3: Series-Defining Result, Lines, Notes & How To Watch
stories.summary: The Minnesota Wild won Game 3 of their NHL Stanley Cup playoff series against the Colorado Avalanche, 5-1, at Grand Casino Arena. The win narrows the Avalanche's series lead to 2-1. The Wild came out strong, playing with a Game 7 mentality. Key players for the Avalanche include C Martin Necas with five points and D Devon Toews with four points, while G Scott Wedgewood has a 2-0 record with a 4.00 GAA and .881 SV%. For the Wild, RW Vladimir Tarasenko leads with 35 points in 50 career games against Colorado. The series continues, with the Avalanche looking to regain their momentum. An outdoor watch party was held, starting at 5 p.m. with the puck drop at 8 p.m. The Wild's win sets up an important Game 4, as they aim to even the series.

stories.headline: Delhi on high alert: Intel agencies warn of terror attacks; security beefed up at BJP HQ
stories.summary: Delhi has been put on high alert due to intelligence inputs indicating a possible terror threat. The warning suggests that terrorists may target key installations across the city using improvised explosive devices (IEDs). As a result, Delhi Police and other security agencies have intensified vigilance across sensitive locations, including high-footfall areas. The alert has led to a strengthening of security measures, with the BJP headquarters being one of the locations where security has been beefed up. Intelligence agencies have warned of potential attacks, prompting the authorities to take precautionary measures to ensure public safety. The high alert status is currently in place, with security agencies remaining vigilant to prevent any potential terror attacks in the national capital. The situation is being closely monitored by the authorities.

stories.headline: DMK’s Periyakaruppan moves Madras HC to prevent TVK MLA from participating in vote of confidence
stories.summary: DMK's K.R. Periyakaruppan has petitioned the Madras High Court to prevent TVK MLA Seenivasa Sethupathy from participating in the vote of confidence. Periyakaruppan, a former DMK minister, lost the Tiruppattur seat to Sethupathy by a single vote in the 2026 Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly elections. The petition cites vote recount issues and seeks to block Sethupathy's participation in the proceedings. If the court orders Sethupathy's exclusion, it would reduce TVK's strength by one vote in the House. The Madras High Court is set to hear Periyakaruppan's plea, which challenges the validity of Sethupathy's win due to the narrow margin of victory. The case has been filed ahead of the vote of confidence, and the court's decision may impact the outcome of the trust vote.

stories.headline: Vijay Insisted On Waiting To Get Letter: Inside Story Of Governor Meet
stories.summary: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) chief Vijay met with Governor Rajendra Arlekar to stake his claim to form the government in Tamil Nadu. The TVK won 108 seats in recent elections, emerging as the largest party but fell short of a majority by 10 seats. The governor insisted that Vijay provide proof of majority support before being invited to form the government. Vijay was told that the letter of appointment would be sent to him in an hour, but he insisted on waiting and received the letter in person an hour later. The governor's demand for documentary proof has complicated the coalition math, posing a setback for Vijay's bid to form the government. Vijay confirmed that he would wait for the letter, saying he would not leave without it.

stories.headline: Ex-EC special observer for SIR Subrata Gupta is now adviser to Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari
stories.summary: Subrata Gupta, a retired IAS officer, has been appointed as an adviser to West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. Gupta, a 1990 batch officer, previously served as the Special Roll Observer for the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in the state, appointed by the Election Commission of India. The West Bengal government issued a notification announcing Gupta's appointment as adviser to the Chief Minister, alongside Shantanu Bala as private secretary. Gupta's appointment is part of the new government's efforts to reshape the Chief Minister's office. The move comes after Gupta's stint as the EC's special observer for the SIR exercise in the state. The appointment is effective as per the government notification, with Gupta set to advise the Chief Minister on various matters.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty outlook for Monday, May 11: What to expect from stock market
stories.summary: Domestic equity markets ended the week in the green, with the BSE Sensex rising 0.53% and the NSE Nifty increasing 0.76%. However, the week ended on a negative note on Friday. The Nifty 50 index previously declined over 250 points, closing below its 20-Day Moving Average (DMA) of 24,737. Despite this, Asian markets have rallied due to growing optimism about a potential US-Iran agreement. The Nifty closed above the 17,700 mark. Market data indicates a mixed outlook for Monday, with key levels to watch. The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty are expected to be influenced by global market trends and domestic economic factors. Investors will be monitoring the markets closely for any significant movements or changes in sentiment. The Nifty Bank and other indices will also be closely watched for any potential shifts in the market.

stories.headline: Indian Stock Market Witnesses Significant Volatility Due to Global Economic Shifts
stories.summary: The Indian stock market has experienced significant volatility due to global economic shifts, resulting in declines and impacting investor confidence. The market has faced substantial losses, with the Sensex losing over 3,000 points, wiping out investors' wealth worth Rs 20.16 lakh crore. The country's heavy dependence on oil imports makes the stock market highly sensitive to international crude price movements. Global risk sentiment and currency markets have also contributed to the market's instability. The energy-importing economy of India is particularly vulnerable to fluctuations in oil prices. As a result, the stock market has ended the week in the red, with major indices such as the Sensex and Nifty experiencing losses, reflecting the uncertainty and instability in the market. This volatility has affected investor wealth and market stability.

stories.headline: Nifty Pharma Index Sees Significant Gains as Investors Flock to Healthcare Sector
stories.summary: The Nifty Pharma Index has seen significant gains as investors flock to the healthcare sector. The index represents India's leading pharmaceutical firms listed on the NSE, including large-cap and mid-cap companies. It reflects investor sentiment in healthcare, R&D pipelines, and global pharmaceutical trends. Recently, pharma stocks have bucked the overall market trend, rising significantly in a falling market. Prominent companies like Sun Pharma are in focus due to market-moving updates and analysis. The Nifty Pharma Index is designed to track the performance of the pharmaceutical sector in India, providing a benchmark for investors to gauge the industry's growth and trends. The index's gains indicate a shift in investor interest towards the healthcare sector, driven by factors such as potential bonus issues, expansion plans, and acquisition bids.

stories.headline: BSE Sensex Ends Week on High Note, Auto and Energy Stocks Lead the Charge
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex ended the week on a high note, driven by gains in auto and energy stocks. The index rose 234 points, with the Nifty nearing 24,400, amid positive global cues. Auto stocks led the rally, strengthened by broader market sentiment and earnings optimism. The Sensex had opened the week cautiously, rising 59 points to 83,793, with the Nifty 50 adding 28 points to 25,847. Technology and energy stocks initially dominated gains. However, the market experienced a late rebound, despite a weekly F&O expiry drag. Oil prices remained above $102, while a weak rupee and FII flows were key market monitorables. The BSE Sensex ultimately closed the week on a positive note, with auto and energy stocks leading the charge. The index's performance was tracked using tools like the BSE Sensex Heat Map, which highlights gainers, losers, and volume toppers.

stories.headline: UK engineering company plunges into administration - in business since 1964 The company specialised in the aerospace sector.
stories.summary: Compact Orbital Gears Limited, a UK-based engineering company, has entered administration. Founded in 1964, the company specializes in the aerospace sector, designing, manufacturing, and supplying gearboxes and test rigs. With over 60 years of operation, the business has been a significant player in the industry. The administration process involves a court freezing the company's assets prior to a hearing to determine potential liquidation. As a result, the company's operations and future are currently uncertain. Compact Orbital Gears Limited's entry into administration is listed among major UK company failures, with daily updates available on businesses in administration throughout the country. The company's specialized expertise in the aerospace sector makes its situation notable within the industry. Further details on the company's insolvency proceedings can be searched and viewed online.

stories.headline: Aadit Palicha-led Zepto gets SEBI approval for $1 billion IPO: Report India’s market regulator has approved the proposed initial public offering (IPO) of quick commerce company Zepto, paving the way for one of the most closely watched
stories.summary: India's market regulator, SEBI, has approved the proposed initial public offering (IPO) of quick commerce company Zepto, led by Aadit Palicha. The approval paves the way for a potential Rs 12,000 crore ($1.2 billion) listing in 2026. Zepto aims to strengthen its position against rivals with the IPO, signaling renewed investor confidence in India's internet and startup listing market. The company is set to file its updated Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) soon, ahead of its highly anticipated market debut. SEBI's approval is a significant step towards Zepto's IPO, which is expected to be one of the most closely watched startup listings in the country this year. The IPO is anticipated to be around $1 billion to $1.2 billion, making it a substantial listing in the Indian market.

stories.headline: Parent company of Trump’s Truth Social site reports $400m loss this year Losses driven largely by depreciation of cryptocurrency assets as prices of digital currencies tumble.
stories.summary: Trump Media, the parent company of Donald Trump's social media platform Truth Social, reported a net loss of $405.9 million in the first quarter of 2026. The loss is a significant increase from $31.7 million a year earlier. Revenue for the quarter was $871,200. The loss was primarily driven by $244 million in unrealized losses on cryptocurrency holdings, as well as an additional $108.2 million investment loss. The company had raised $2.5 billion to invest in cryptocurrencies last year, but declining prices in the sector have led to significant depreciation of these assets. The net loss of over $400 million reflects the impact of these declining cryptocurrency values on the company's financial performance.

stories.headline: CTS (CTS) has caught investor attention after first quarter 2026 earnings exceeded analyst expectations and management raised full year sales guidance, prompting
stories.summary: CTS Corporation reported strong first-quarter 2026 results, with year-on-year sales growth to $139.23 million and net income to $17.2 million. The company narrowed its full-year sales guidance range to $560 million, indicating sustained top-line growth and margin improvement. Similarly, AAON raised its full-year 2026 outlook, expecting revenue growth of 40-45% and a gross margin of 27-28%. In contrast, Corteva, Inc. beat its Q1 2026 earnings forecast but saw its stock dip. Other companies, such as Disney, also reported strong first-quarter results, with guidance pointing to sustained growth and robust cash generation. These earnings reports reflect a positive trend in the industry, with companies exceeding expectations and raising their outlook for the remainder of 2026. The strong performance is driven by factors such as scaling growth and margin improvement.
